modules.name: comment
modules.text:
When recording audio tracks, we have to account for any delays in the system so that the tracks remain synchronized.

So we added a round-trip latency measurement feature to Syntona.

To Do:
* Open the "Settings..." from the File menu.
* Click the "Latency" tab.
* Click the "Measure" or "Measure Again" button.

You should hear some short noise bursts. If there is a microphone active then Syntona can measure the round-trip latency.

If you are using an external USB audio interface then you may need to connect loopback cables.
Connect a 1/4" cable (guitar cord) between the output #1 and input #1 on your USB interface.
Then run the Latency Measurement again.

The latency measurement will be stored for that combination of audio input and output device.
